messages:
zoe: Heads-up  partner surfaced an old staging backup in a shared bucket. Its KMS-encrypted but includes Vault transit blobs and a small manifest with svc account ids. No plaintext seen, but treat as exposure and run containment.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20260415-21  priority=high  owner=eng-security  link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260415-21 :rotating_light:

marta: Can you paste the S3 path and filenames? were objects public?

zoe: s3://partner-exchange/backups/staging_2026-04-15.tar.gz
files: staging/enc_creds.kms, staging/manifest.yaml
manifest includes: vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent, svc_ids=[staging-agent, event-replay], prev_kms=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333:key/old-abc
Partner says it was briefly public (ACL mistake) but now private.

ops-jen: Immediate items: 1) copy to our quarantine bucket with object-lock 2) enable detailed Vault audit for secret/data/staging/agent -> forward to splunk 90d 3) prepare a dedicated KMS rotor key and grant for rewrap 4) draft RBAC deny for non-ci-staging principals. I can take 1+2 now.

kai: Quarantined to s3://redwood-quarantine/4456789012/ and set object-lock + 48h TTL.

lucas: Forensics: run quick vault audit filter to list reads on the path in the last 90d. Example: 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {time:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log
```
Post any unknown accessors here.

marta: I ran that; two entries show partner-ci-consumer and one unknown accessor id: f77e2. Forwarded full logs to splunk and attached to the incident.

ops-jen: RBAC: draft deny rule (casbin) ready -> push via infra pipeline with immediate rollout flag: 
```
# allow reads only for ci-staging role
p, role:ci-staging, secret/data/staging/agent, read, allow
p, *, secret/data/staging/agent, read, deny
```
I'll monitor for any breakage and have rollback ready.

kai: KMS plan: create alias/kms-rotor-stg-2026, restrict to re-encrypt/decrypt from ops-rewrap-role in ops VPC. Use aws kms re-encrypt on the blob and DO NOT return rewrapped ciphertext to partner. Then issue fresh creds to partner if needed and require deletion proof.

lucas: Rewrap command example: 
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://staging/enc_creds.kms --destination-key-id alias/kms-rotor-stg-2026 --source-encryption-context VaultTransit=true --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > creds.rewrapped.kms
```
Do not upload creds.rewrapped.kms back to partner.

zoe: Partner must delete their copy. We'll ask for delete-marker + object version as proof and a signed attestation from partner security. Prefer we just re-issue new short-lived creds for their consumers and confirm deletion.

ops-jen: Snapshot the vault metadata (redacted) and store in secure audit bucket with TTL=48h: 
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.secret)' > /tmp/staging-meta.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-meta.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/4456789012.json --sse aws:kms
```
Limit bucket ACL to sec-team-only.

sec-bot: INC-20260415-21 update: quarantine=true, snapshot_uploaded=true, audit_forwarding_enabled=true

kai: Creating KMS key now (alias/kms-rotor-stg-2026). ETA ~20m. Will create least-privileged grant and start re-encrypt once ready.

marta: After rewrap finish plan: 1) rotate any long-lived tokens tied to the svc_ids 2) issue short TTL tokens and update running tasks 3) revoke old leases and remove old accessor ids 4) keep RBAC deny until tokens validated and partner deletion proof provided.

lucas: One more ask: run a quick scan for any other partner archives that reference vault paths (grep manifests) and list matches. If multiples, treat as campaign and escalate.

zoe: Good call. I'll run a scan of partner buckets and report back.

ops-jen: Scheduling a 20m sync with partner security + oncall in 30m to hand off rewrap and collection of deletion evidence. Will send invite.

kai: KMS key created and grant provisioned. Starting re-encrypt now. Not returning rewrapped blob. ETA ~12m.

sec-bot: INC-20260415-21 update: kms_rewrap_started=true, responder=kai

marta: Checklist I'm tracking: quarantine, snapshot, audit-forward, kms-create/rewrap in progress, rbac-deny applied, tokens rotate pending, partner deletion proof pending, post-incident review TBD. I'll update when rewrap completes. :white_check_mark:
